subject: Deploy latest Candidate 01 blank-space collapse fix
body: Deploy Candidate 01 branch SHA 1753754c1845ab3941414ae3693524d057acbae6 to the local Doré Design resident. This supersedes the earlier reversible-mosaic deployment request that targeted 15528d185eaf52916f8fefff72cc19c6e19cfe97. Required visible behavior: four horizontal 8:5 cards assemble into one horizontal 8:5 master window; moving pointer onto blank space during arrest, assemble, or focus immediately triggers release; the window splits back into four cards and drift resumes. Do not alter public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'pointerPolicy' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'pointOnOriginalCard' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'mosaic-assemble' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'animatePieces(false)'
